why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Nolan Gorman is slot #3 (4.146 expected team runs/game).
Slots #3, #7, #6, #8, #4, #9, #2, #5 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #5 ranks 8 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.010 R/G.
Slot #3 yields 4.41 expected PA/game vs 4.20 at primary slot #5. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
